archetype: LUXURY & THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Barber Club & Tactical Precision)

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand gold badge + SaaS positioning left, interactive tenant selector and preview booking mockup right
entry_surfaces./b/:slug: barbershop public storefront — branded banner header, quick stats, services catalog, active barbers, floating whatsapp & AI assistant, primary gold CTA 'Agendar Horário'
entry_surfaces./b/:slug/agendar: mobile-first 4-step wizard container — step indicator progress bar, selectable items, responsive sticky bottom navigation
entry_surfaces./cliente: client hub — subscription card with remaining cuts badge, 10-stamp loyalty card grid, appointments timeline, referral invite box
entry_surfaces./admin: barbershop operations panel — daily schedule grid by barber, quick encaixe button, comanda checkout drawer, finance metric cards
entry_surfaces./superadmin: tenant management console — SaaS global MRR, active/suspended barbershops table with quick toggle, onboard new tenant modal

visual_enhancers.texture: subtle dark noise grain and 1px metallic gold border accents (#D4AF37/25)
visual_enhancers.gold_gradient_text: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F5D061] via-[#D4AF37] to-[#AA7C11] bg-clip-text text-transparent

grids_and_layouts.mobile_pwa: Mobile-first full screen container with max-w-md mx-auto on mobile, expanding to max-w-7xl on desktop viewports. Bottom safe-area padding for mobile navigation.
booking_wizard_steps: Passo 1: Seleção de Serviços (Cards interativos com duração, preço e multi-seleção)
Passo 2: Barbeiro / Profissional (Avatar com iniciais/foto, especialidades em badges, nota de 1 a 5 estrelas)
Passo 3: Data e Horário (Calendário compacto + grade de horários disponíveis em pills/chips)
Passo 4: Pagamento & Confirmação (Opções: Pix com QR Code + Copia e Cola, Cartão Crédito/Débito, Saldo do Plano de Assinatura '1 corte restante')

client_area.loyalty_card: Grid de 10 selos estilizados com ícone de tesoura/navalha dourada para carimbos preenchidos e pontilhado para pendentes
client_area.subscription_box: Card estilo cartão black/gold com medidor circular ou barra de progresso 'Restam 3 de 4 cortes'
client_area.appointments: Lista de agendamentos futuros e passados com botões 'Cancelar', 'Reagendar' e 'Avaliar (1-5 estrelas)'
client_area.referral_box: Código exclusivo de indicação com botão copiar link e contador de créditos ganhos

admin_dashboard.agenda_diaria: Timeline/colunas por profissional com slots de 30m, indicador de status (Confirmado, Em Andamento, Concluído, Bloqueio, Encaixe)
admin_dashboard.comanda_checkout: Drawer lateral para fechamento de comanda: adicionar produtos (pomada, óleo de barba), serviços extras, gorjeta, aplicar desconto/assinatura e registrar pagamento
admin_dashboard.quick_actions: Botão rápido 'Novo Encaixe', 'Bloquear Horário', 'Enviar Lembrete WhatsApp'
admin_dashboard.financeiro: Cards de faturamento bruto, líquido, comissões por barbeiro, ticket médio e botão 'Exportar Relatório (Excel/PDF)'

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with y-offset of 6px over 0.2s ease-out
motion.step_transitions: Slide horizontal transition for booking wizard steps
motion.badge_stamp: Scale-up bounce effect (scale: 0.8 to 1.15 to 1) when loyalty stamp is marked
motion.drawer_spring: Spring transition for mobile sheets (comanda, chatbot)

accessibility.minimum_contrast: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 against their designated surfaces. Gold #D4AF37 on dark #0D0D11 yields 8.2:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px touch targets for all primary buttons, tab triggers, and appointment slot chips.
accessibility.aria_labels: Clear aria-labels for WhatsApp floating trigger, chatbot toggle, stamp counters, and star rating buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme: Modern luxurious dark mode (#0D0D11 background, #18181B panels, rich gold #D4AF37 accents, crisp white text). Always replace <html class='dark'> in frontend/index.html if needed.

Images: DO NOT generate AI images. Use Lucide icons (Scissors, Calendar, Clock, DollarSign, Award, Star, MessageSquare, User, ShieldCheck, Share2, QrCode, Phone, Sparkles) and stylish SVG avatars / monogram initials for barbers and users.
Language: Complete interface in Portuguese (Brazil) with natural barber terms (Corte Degradê, Barba Terapia, Sobrancelha, Pomada Modeladora, Encaixe, Comanda, Selos Fidelidade, Assinatura Clube).
PWA/Mobile Experience: Implement bottom action bars for mobile booking wizard (ex: 'Continuar (R$ 65,00) ->'), floating WhatsApp button, and quick tab switching.

Interactive Mock Flows: Ensure all tabs and actions work seamlessly in the single-page application (switch tenant, schedule appointment with complete 4 steps, review booking, cancel/reschedule, loyalty stamp simulation, comanda checkout, Pix QR code copy, export mock PDF/Excel).
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, step triggers, inputs, cards, action menus).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or low-contrast gray text on dark backgrounds.
Maintain strict TypeScript types across all UI components and hooks.
Use Sonner for toast notifications ('Agendamento confirmado!', 'Código Pix copiado!', 'Comanda fechada com sucesso!').
Ensure all dialogs, sheets, and popovers have solid dark backgrounds (#18181B) with crisp borders (#27272A) to prevent visual clipping.
